source_facts.C_compact: The exact outer producer returns n_active by48 words, no capacity padding; n_active0 returns an empty matrix with output_shape[0,48].
source_facts.d_active_slots: finish_callback enumerates installation active flags in ascending owner-slot order before quiet markers. C row k corresponds to d[k], not slot k.
source_facts.consumer_call: Meter worker passes outer.matrix_words and model_destination_indices directly to component_callback.
source_facts.P_legacy_packed: The exact dynamic adapter appends(15-n)*48 positive-zero words to C, and pairs those rows with d followed by the ascending inactive slots. This is a full15-row packed/permutation representation, not dense target-slot row order.
source_facts.marker_preview: The prototype also mixes C/d purely for marker energy using immutable installed48 and previous component overlap. This does not itself advance component state.

derived_clean_adapter_decision.D_dense: Canonical15x48 target-slot view. Initialize all cells to positive-zero F32 bits00000000, then D[d[k],s]=C[k,s] by exact word copy.
derived_clean_adapter_decision.scatter: Compact C and ordered unique d -> canonical dense D. Preserve every active coefficient bit pattern.
derived_clean_adapter_decision.gather: Canonical dense D and the same ordered d -> C'[k,s]=D[d[k],s]. A consumer expecting compact n_active rows must gather; it must not blindly use D row k.
derived_clean_adapter_decision.inactive_rule: Canonical inactive D rows are positive zero. Active all-zero rows remain active according to d; do not infer d from nonzero coefficients.
derived_clean_adapter_decision.packed_capacity_alternative: If a fixed15x48 storage is defined as packed active-prefix capacity instead, call it P and carry its full destination permutation. Never call P dense or interchange it with D without an explicit adapter.
derived_clean_adapter_decision.component_equivalence: C/d, D/identity0..14, and P/full permutation supply each active output the same ordered(source index,coefficient bits) terms. Inactive terms are skipped under existingF04A c<=0 rule; the numeric kernel and later component state/update order are unchanged.
derived_clean_adapter_decision.validation: n0..15; C word count48*n; d lengthn, unique integer0..14. Selected production d is ascending installed-slot order. A primitive adapter may preserve any given paired unique order but never sort d alone.
derived_clean_adapter_decision.mask_not_permutation: The dense identity-row list and legacy full permutation are stateless mixer transport maps only. Keep the real active_target_indices=d separately for outer, marker and owner state. Do not turn padded inactive rows into active targets.

current_vs_next.current_callback: Capture d and C from installation/outer before marker quiet.
current_vs_next.next_target_state: Quiet-after active flags update next state, not current C row count or d.
current_vs_next.empty_selection: Empty selected IDs preserve old active flags perF03G. Thus selected_count0 does not imply n_active0; old installed targets can still require a nonempty matrix.
current_vs_next.cold: A cold zero matrix is only initialization. A produced zero result is valid only after this callback's producer executes, including the n0 empty-target branch.
current_vs_next.zero_output: n0 or zero coefficients do not allow skipping component overlap/ring/filter advancement; old history may still contribute.
